blocks.text: We frequently have openings for exceptional students who wish to pursue a Ph.D. in Computer Science or Complex Systems and Data Science.

We are looking for bright, hardworking students interested in research and scholarship opportunities. Email a copy of your CV/Resume to safwan.wshah@uvm.edu. Ideal applicants should have advanced knowledge of deep learning with at least one high-quality publication, experience programming with Python, experience working with common deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow, etc.).
